name: Petra Moroccan Mints [40pk] (100mg THC)
description:
A surprising combination of green tea matcha and peppermint extract, our sugar-free, plant-based Moroccan Mint Petra soothes with a hint of peppermint and light notes of Tahitian vanilla. Made in a facility that processes milk, nuts, soy and gluten. 

2.5mg THC per serving 100mg THC per pack 40 mints per pack
